plugins.name: ctx
plugins.description: Context window details like the Desktop app's panel: /ctx opens a pane that docks beside the transcript, and a 📊 button above the prompt toggles it

plugins.name: subagent-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar above the prompt and a live agents panel for any subagent work, each subagent a crab whose costume follows its model and effort. Fork of johnnyvizz's savvy-progress.

plugins.name: prompt-upgrade
plugins.description: Turns a rough prompt into a great one before it is sent: /better asks up to three quick questions, rewrites the prompt and shows original and upgrade side by side. Nothing runs until you press Run. Idea and spec from https://tristenobrien.ai/.
